title: Lender-Placed Flood Master Programs — Rate and Term Schedule
content:
Each tier of the **Lender-Placed Flood Master Programs** carries the rates, minimum premium, term and proration basis below.

## Terms of the schedule
- **Building rate per 100:** annual rate per 100 USD of certificate building limit.
- **Contents rate per 100:** annual rate per 100 USD of certificate contents limit (0 where unavailable).
- **Minimum certificate premium:** lowest annual premium of one certificate.
- **Certificate term:** term of one certificate from its coverage effective date, in calendar months.
- **Proration basis:** basis for any partial-term premium or credit.

| Tier | Building rate per 100 | Contents rate per 100 | Minimum certificate premium |
|---|---|---|---|
| Lender-Placed Flood – Residential Mandatory Amount | 0.95 | 0 | 150 dollars |
| Lender-Placed Flood – Residential Gap | 0.85 | 0 | 100 dollars |
| Lender-Placed Flood – Residential Replacement Cost | 0.9 | 0 | 200 dollars |
| Lender-Placed Flood – Manufactured Home | 1.35 | 0 | 175 dollars |
| Lender-Placed Flood – Commercial Building | 1.1 | 0 | 300 dollars |
| Lender-Placed Flood – Commercial Building and Contents | 1.1 | 1.25 | 400 dollars |

| Term common to every tier | Value |
|---|---|
| Certificate term | 12 calendar months |
| Proration basis | Daily pro rata |

## Scoped exceptions stated by the program's schedules
- **Rates.** For a new placement on the loan named on the most recently mailed first notice of a program on the Residential Mandatory Amount tier, and only for such a placement, the annual premium is set by the residential placement schedule in place of the base premium formula; for every certificate that renews under a program on the Residential Mandatory Amount tier, and only for such renewals, the premium for the renewed term is the renewed building limit divided by 100 times the program renewal rate per 100 in effect on the renewal date, rounded to the cent and never less than the tier's minimum certificate premium; and for a commercial placement on the loan named on the most recently mailed first notice of a program on the Commercial Building tier, and only for such a placement, the annual premium is set by the commercial placement schedule in place of the base premium formula.
- **Proration basis.** for the overlap credit on the certificate named on the acceptable borrower evidence most recently received on the program, and only for that credit, the credit and its effective date are figured by the overlap schedule; and for a loan event that the lender reports on the day it takes effect, on the certificate most recently issued under the program, and only for such an event, the loan-event credit is figured by the loan-event schedule.

## Notes on the schedule
- The two commercial tiers share a building rate of 1.1 per 100 but differ in minimum premium (300 dollars against 400 dollars) and in contents rate.
- Lender-Placed Flood – Manufactured Home carries the highest building rate, 1.35 per 100; Lender-Placed Flood – Residential Gap the lowest, 0.85 per 100.
